newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa JSE records highest number of deals ever. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: S.Africa JSE records highest number of deals ever. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: A record number of deals was executed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on Monday as the expiry of the September 1996 futures contract made for hectic activity, JSE president Roy Andersen said.
"12,354 deals were executed today, the biggest number in the JSE's 109-year history," Andersen told Reuters.
He said the previous record for the number of deals carried out on a single day dated back to October 28 (corrects from October 25), 1987 when 9,544 deals took place.
The value of shares traded on Monday also took their place in the JSE's record books. Shares worth 958.2 million rand changed hands, the second biggest value ever traded on the bourse, Andersen said.
The highest value was recorded on April 9 this year when shares worth 999.7 million rand changed hands.
However, Andersen said activity on that day included 715 million rand's worth of trade from the purchase by Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd of a stake in Lonrho Ltd.
"When it comes to pure trading, taking out the corporate finance deals, today (Monday) is the highest ever," Andersen said.
